celestial_agenda.name: Celestial Agenda
description: ::ab{title="&L&Celestial Agenda&FN&" icon=power-down-learn info="While good deities and empyreal lords have organized faiths to carry out their wills, powerfully ranked ‹family/agathion«s›, ‹family/angel«s›, and ‹family/archon«s› - and occasional intersectional councils of good outsiders - sometimes invest white witches with celestial might to defend the weak and heal the sick." order=napxy ability="You gain the ‹hex/ward› hex at 1st level." passive="Your patron holds you to a higher standard: you must be of good alignment, and you take a -2 penalty on Bluff, Intimidate, Sleight of Hand, and other skill checks to deceive or threaten others." xAvailable_Patron_Themes="‹patron/Endurance›, ‹patron/Healing›, ‹patron/Light›, ‹patron/Portents›" yPatron_Spells="This unique patron grants these alternate spells at the listed witch levels." s4=Castigate s10=Rebuke s16="Greater planar ally|(good outsiders only)"}

empath.name: Empath
description: ::ab{title="&L&Empath&FN&" icon=power-down-learn info="Your patron is a manifestation of the collective living experience - mortal desire and purpose given direction by the beliefs of countless minds and hearts." order=napxy ability="You gain the ‹hex/tongues› hex at 1st level" passive="You cannot help but feel the despair, pain, and other negative emotions in those around you, taking a -5 penalty on saving throws against emotion effects." xAvailable_Patron_Themes="‹patron/Ancestors›, ‹patron/Mind›, ‹patron/Spirits›, ‹patron/Wisdom›" yPatron_Spells="This unique patron grants these alternate spells at the listed witch levels." s2="Burst of insight" s6="Analyze aura" s10=Retrocognition}

fey_gifts.name: Fey Gifts
description: ::ab{title="&L&Fey Gifts&FN&" icon=power-down-learn info="A powerful fey or other entity from the First World has offered you magic. You serve as an anchor and scrying focus in the Material Plane for your patron, but you also provide frequent amusement." order=napxy ability="You gain the ‹hex/charm› hex at 1st level." passive="Your fey patron delights in your failure and injury and frequently jinxes you; once each day, the GM can demand you reroll a single ability check, attack roll, saving throw, or skill check and use the worse result." xAvailable_Patron_Themes="‹patron/Agility›, ‹patron/Enchantment›, ‹patron/Trickery›, ‹patron/Winter›" yPatron_Spells="This unique patron grants these alternate spells at the listed witch levels." s2="Disguise self" s4="Hideous laughter" s16="Irresistible dance"}

green_whispers.name: Green Whispers
description: ::ab{title="&L&Green Whispers&FN&" icon=power-down-learn info="Your witch powers are a manifestation of the ‹faith/Green Faith› or bestowed by a representative of natural forces, such as an ancient ‹monster/treant› or nature spirit, who expects you to wield such gifts on its behalf." order=napxy ability="You gain the ‹hex/feral speech› hex at 1st level." passive="You cannot abide the touch of iron or steel; contact with either metal deals 1d3 points of damage each round, and wearing metal armor prevents you from casting spells until it is removed." xAvailable_Patron_Themes="‹patron/Animals›, ‹patron/Endurance›, ‹patron/Moon›, ‹patron/Transformation›" yPatron_Spells="This unique patron grants these alternate spells at the listed witch levels." s2=Entangle s6="Plant growth" s10="Tree stride"}

hags_calling.name: Hag's Calling
description: ::ab{title="&L&Hag's Calling&FN&" icon=power-down-learn info="Hags of exceptional power - most often ‹monster/mute hag«s› and ‹monster/dreamthief hag«s› - sometimes invest mortal agents with the same well of ancient power they have mastered. Hags most often invest their ‹race/changeling› daughters with such power, either once they have proven loyal or else to tempt them into wickedness." order=napxy ability="You gain the ‹hex/coven› hex at 1st level." passive="You can neither use the ‹rule/aid another› action nor receive benefits from others' aid another actions." xAvailable_Patron_Themes="‹patron/Moon›, ‹patron/Plague›, ‹patron/Shadow›, ‹patron/Vengeance›" yPatron_Spells="This unique patron grants these alternate spells at the listed witch levels." s2="Disguise self" s8=Sending s10="Commune|(hag/patron rather than deity)"}

infernal_contract.name: Infernal Contract
description: ::ab{title="&L&Infernal Contract&FN&" icon=power-down-learn info="Your power was brokered from a powerful ‹family/daemon›, ‹family/demon›, or ‹family/devil› to speed the corruption and moral decay of mortals. When you die, your soul goes to Abaddon, the Abyss, or Hell, and you can't be raised or resurrected except by extraordinary means - though bold service may earn you a favored position in damnation." order=napxy ability="You gain the ‹hex/misfortune› hex at 1st level." passive="Your magic requires sacrifice; each day when you prepare spells, you must deal 1d6 points of damage to yourself as part of your infernal ritual, feeding the lost blood to your familiar." incrementPlain="You must~0~5" incrementDesc=deal incrementEnd="d6 damage to yourself to get your spells." xAvailable_Patron_Themes="‹patron/Enchantment›, ‹patron/Strength›, ‹patron/Trickery›, ‹patron/Vengeance›" yPatron_Spells="This unique patron grants these alternate spells at the listed witch levels." s8="Lesser planar ally" s12="Planar ally" s16="Greater planar ally|(your bonus spells can be used to summon only the type of outsider your patron represents)"}

shadowbound.name: Shadowbound
description: ::ab{title="&L&Shadowbound&FN&" icon=power-down-learn info="Deep exposure to entities from the Plane of Shadow - ‹family/kyton«s›, ‹family/nightshade«s›, ‹monster/owb«s›, and similar ethereal forces - has infused you with shadow." order=napxy ability="You gain the ‹hex/disguise› hex at 1st level." passive="You also gain ‹umr/light blindness›." xAvailable_Patron_Themes="‹patron/Death›, ‹patron/Deception›, ‹patron/Ethereal›, ‹patron/Shadow›" yPatron_Spells="This unique patron grants these alternate spells at the listed witch levels." s8="Shadow conjuration" s12="Shadow walk" s16="Greater shadow evocation"}

the_condition_of_all.name: The Condition of All
description: ::ab{title="&L&The Condition of All&FN&" icon=power-down-learn info="‹family/Aeon«s› are often patrons to witches, seeking out mortals who share their vested interest in some agenda that helps them promote the cosmic balance." order=napxy ability="You gain the ‹hex/scar› hex at 1st level." passive="Your patron requires unwavering commitment to their cause, and you lose your spellcasting and hexes (but not your familiar) if your alignment changes after taking your first witch level; you regain your spellcasting and hexes once you revert to your original alignment." xAvailable_Patron_Themes="‹patron/Elements›, ‹patron/Time›, ‹patron/Transformation›, ‹patron/Wisdom›" yPatron_Spells="This unique patron grants these alternate spells at the listed witch levels." s2="Forbid action" s8=Dismissal s12="Geas/quest"}

touched_by_the_outer_gods.name: Touched by the Outer Gods
description: ::ab{title="&L&Touched by the Outer Gods&FN&" icon=power-down-learn info="Your powers hail from an incomprehensible being from beyond the stars, whose motivations and needs erode your psyche." order=napxy ability="You gain the ‹hex/unnerve beasts› hex at 1st level." passive="You take a -2 penalty on saving throws against confusion and emotion effects and are affected by such effects for at least 1 round even on a successful saving throw." xAvailable_Patron_Themes="‹patron/Insanity›, ‹patron/Occult›, ‹patron/Stars›, ‹patron/Transformation›" yPatron_Spells="This unique patron grants these alternate spells at the listed witch levels." s2="Lesser confusion" s8=Dreadscape s10="Compelling rant"}
